controls.regle: The choice of each AI model used (provider, size, version) is justified by documented criteria (cost, performance, latency, sovereignty) and validated by a designated authority before going into production.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a model selection note per AI use case, listing the alternatives considered, the selection criteria, and the validation by the designated authority.
controls.preuve_attendue: Documented model selection note (alternatives, criteria, decision) + validation record.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = choice documented and validated for all models in production ; partial = choice documented without a recorded validation ; non-compliant = model in production without documented justification
actions_audit: List the AI models used in production and their associated use case.
Request the selection note and its validation for each model.
If gap: document the choice retroactively and have it validated by the designated authority.
standards: DAMA-DMBOK2 — Chapitre 3 (Data Governance, par extension à la gouvernance des modèles)

controls.regle: Prompts (system, user, templates) are versioned in a dedicated registry, outside of the frozen application code, with a tracked change history and verification before publication.
controls.verification: Verify that the prompts are externalized from the compiled code, versioned (registry, versioned files or prompt manager), and that each change is tracked with a review before deployment to production.
controls.preuve_attendue: Extract from the prompt registry with version history + review record of the last published change.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = prompts versioned outside the code, tracked history, review before publication ; partial = prompts versioned without a formalized review ; non-compliant = prompts hardcoded in the code without versioning
actions_audit: Identify the location of the prompts (code, configuration file, dedicated registry).
Verify the version history of the last significant prompt change and its review.
If gap: externalize the prompts and set up versioning and review.

controls.regle: The response quality of each model in production is continuously measured using a representative evaluation set (canary) and declared metrics, against explicit thresholds.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of an evaluation set representative of the use case, declared quality metrics (accuracy, relevance, format) with thresholds, and the actual execution frequency of the evaluation.
controls.preuve_attendue: Evaluation set (canary) + definition of metrics and thresholds + history of executions and results.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = regular automated evaluation with documented and met metrics/thresholds ; partial = one-off evaluation or unformalized thresholds ; non-compliant = absence of quality evaluation
actions_audit: Request the representative evaluation set and the definition of metrics/thresholds.
Verify the frequency and results of the latest evaluation runs.
If gap: build the evaluation set and automate its periodic execution.

controls.regle: The inputs and outputs of each model are filtered by guardrails (dangerous content, personal data, prompt injection attempts) before being transmitted to the user or the downstream system.
controls.verification: Verify the configuration of the content filters (input and output), test a prompt injection attempt and a request for sensitive content, and confirm that they are blocked or flagged.
controls.preuve_attendue: Content filter configuration + result of a prompt injection test and a sensitive content request test.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = active filtering on input and output, bypass tests blocked ; partial = partial filtering (input or output only) ; non-compliant = absence of guardrails or successful bypass
actions_audit: Inspect the input and output guardrail configuration of the model(s) in production.
Replay a prompt injection test and a personal data request; verify that they are blocked.
If gap: activate or strengthen the missing guardrails and document the coverage achieved.
standards: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025 — LLM01 (Prompt Injection), LLM06 (Sensitive Information Disclosure)
RGPD — art. 25 (protection des données dès la conception)

controls.regle: The hallucination rate (responses not grounded in the sources or incorrect) of each model in production is measured, bounded by a declared acceptability threshold, and is subject to a reduction plan in case of breach.
controls.verification: Verify the hallucination detection method (comparison against sources, LLM-as-judge, user feedback), the declared acceptability threshold, and the history of measurements against this threshold.
controls.preuve_attendue: Method and history of hallucination rate measurement + declared threshold + reduction plan in case of breach.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = rate continuously measured, below the declared threshold, reduction plan in place in case of breach ; partial = one-off measurement or unformalized threshold ; non-compliant = no measurement of the hallucination rate
actions_audit: Request the hallucination rate measurement method and its recent history.
Compare the measured rate to the declared acceptability threshold.
If gap: instrument the measurement and define the threshold and the associated reduction plan.
standards: NIST AI RMF 1.0 — fonction Measure (fiabilité, exactitude)

controls.regle: A fallback strategy (backup model, degraded response, human escalation) is defined and tested for cases of unavailability, quota reached, or content refusal by the primary model.
controls.verification: Verify the documentation of the fallback strategy and its actual triggering during a simulated unavailability test of the primary model (switchover to the backup model or controlled degradation).
controls.preuve_attendue: Fallback strategy documentation + result of a switchover test (simulated unavailability).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = strategy documented and successfully tested ≤ 12 months ago ; partial = strategy documented without a recent test ; non-compliant = absence of a fallback strategy
actions_audit: Request the documentation of the fallback strategy (backup model, degradation, escalation).
Simulate an unavailability of the primary model and verify the switchover behavior.
If gap: define the missing fallback strategy and schedule a switchover test.
standards: DORA (Accelerate) — reprise de service (par analogie de résilience)

controls.regle: The consumption and inference cost of each model in production are continuously monitored, with alerts on consumption drift thresholds.
controls.verification: Verify the instrumentation of consumption tracking (tokens, calls, cost) per model and use case, and the existence of alerts configured on threshold breaches.
controls.preuve_attendue: Dashboard or export of consumption/inference cost per model + threshold alert configuration.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = continuous tracking per model with active threshold alerts ; partial = tracking in place without configured alerts ; non-compliant = absence of consumption tracking
actions_audit: Extract the consumption/inference cost tracking per model over the recent period.
Verify the configuration of the consumption drift threshold alerts.
If gap: instrument the missing tracking and configure the alerts.

controls.regle: Any interaction classified as sensitive (risky content, decision impacting a person, low model confidence) triggers a human review before final action or transmission.
controls.verification: Verify the classification criteria triggering a human review, and test a case classified as sensitive to confirm the interruption of the automatic flow and the escalation to a human reviewer.
controls.preuve_attendue: Documented classification criteria + record of a real or simulated case escalated to human review.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = criteria documented and systematic escalation verified ; partial = criteria documented without proven systematic escalation ; non-compliant = absence of a human review mechanism
actions_audit: Request the classification criteria triggering human review.
Replay a simulated sensitive case and verify the actual escalation to a human reviewer.
If gap: define the missing criteria and instrument the escalation.

controls.regle: Every interaction with an AI model (prompt, context, response, decision metadata) is logged in a usable way, to allow the retrospective audit of a contested response.
controls.verification: Select a recent interaction and verify that it can be found in the logs with the complete prompt, the response, the model used, and the timestamp.
controls.preuve_attendue: Log extract of a recent AI interaction (prompt, response, model, timestamp).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% of interactions logged and usable for the audit ; partial = partial logging (sampling or missing fields) ; non-compliant = interactions not logged
actions_audit: Choose a recent AI interaction and search for it in the application logs.
Verify the presence of all the fields necessary for the audit (prompt, response, model, timestamp).
If gap: complete the missing logging instrumentation.
